name: SaaS & Technology
purpose: Product-aware guidance for SaaS, software platforms, AI products, developer tools, workflow systems and B2B/B2C technology products.
productPrinciple: The product workflow, user outcome, evidence, pricing/access model and conversion path are the product. Abstract technology aesthetics must never substitute for showing what the software actually does.
primaryJourneys: start trial, request demo or contact sales
rejectConditions: design before research gate is ready
generic AI gradients and floating orbs with no product meaning
fake dashboards or fabricated product screenshots
invented integrations, customers, uptime, security certifications or metrics
pricing or trial claims not verified
marketing site that never demonstrates the product workflow
prototype functionality presented as a real integration
